name: Remodel an established scar into native dermis
description: Convert a mature fibrotic dermal scar back into dermis with native matrix organisation and appendages — reversal, not prevention.

grade.note: No therapy reverses established fibrosis in any organ; approved antifibrotics slow progression (Henderson 2020, review). For dermal scar specifically, no reversal demonstration was located. The rung is L0 on the strength of a contradicting review, not an absence of search.
